accepted_scope: Prepare the independent implementation and submit it for source review only. No metadata freeze, checkpoint load, model execution, service activation, training, generation, score calculation or new Tiny gate is authorized by this necessity review.
findings: The fixed geometry pairing has sufficient predeclared coverage to justify considering this bounded input intervention; this is not a repeat of the closed whole-reference 69-pair classification proposal.

The question is explicitly limited to the two legitimate 1213FIT final trajectories relative to current reconstructed unadapted states. It does not claim to explain the formal 1313/93 acquisition advantage, separate immediate acquisition from forgetting, or reproduce historical S0 bitwise.

Holding each own question/context/answer fixed while applying the frozen donor bijection can measure paired-image gold-support changes under the actual verified inference path; a donor is not assumed to make gold false.
The protocol requires image-source/cache binding and packed feature hashes as well as nonvisual tensor/layout equality. A mismatch closes the whole fixed diagnostic instead of permitting pair rescue.
Task/domain QA weighting and overall equal-domain weighting are fixed before NLL values. Original-image improvement, wrong-image change, DeltaC and relative D are all reported.

The stated candidate direction combines OSFT original-image improvement, positive DeltaC and positive D, with qv original-image improvements and relative differences visible; it is not a significance, generation-F1 or knowledge test.

The full-row.answer target explicitly differs from the old 512-token truncation plus EOS. Actual called-loss identity, permitted AST delta, target length, EOS and model position limit must be checked by the later source/admission path.
implementation_requirements_already_in_p: Bind legitimate after checkpoints, original complete proofs, current shared processor/package/source files, base assets and each method reconstructed before state; do not substitute formal 1313 weights.

No added NLL warmups, target selection, truncation, pair replacement or conditioning changes beyond the fixed 488 requests; all loading/SVD/hash/visual/observation work is charged inside each state cap.
Record actual image provenance and ensure caches cannot silently return original-image features for a wrong-image request. Same-view visual features and targets must reconcile across all four states.
Verify inference parameter and weight-buffer invariance, complete four-state exit/provenance/budget records and a single scalar-only verifier. Partial values cannot guide changes.
First model STARTED followed by failure/interruption/nonfinite/layout conflict/timeout closes the whole point; no resume, rerun or numeric-backend rescue.
limits: Calibration/logit scale, answer prefixes, geometry-conditioned sample composition, modality and dependence still limit interpretation even if input guards pass.
A positive result would support an observed conditional-response target for a compact carrier; it does not select a compression family or identify necessary OSFT parameters.
A negative result withdraws this specific support-based account, not all image use or useful adaptation, and does not justify deleting vision weights.
This diagnostic is supporting research, not a compact framework, full-weight reduction result or paper contribution by itself.
review_scope: Read MODEL_PROTOCOL and bound existing pairing/review small files; no new source implementation approval or model/data execution.
